rule: An observation earns credit for a labelled activity when it identifies the same piece of work in that message (the same target and the same problem or request), whatever verb it uses; framing is scored by state and stall. A different piece of work earns no credit, even inside the label's span. No partial credit. (src/bench.py, score-v6)
user_words: Examine the six partial matches from the 32-pair audit and determine which deserve full activity credit, partial credit, or no credit under a consistent definition. Address the known incorrect match involving 902#1 so it does not inflate the reported activity recall.
